propositions: run_pass1 and shed_to_budget lack an injection point for explicit budget cap overrides; the only current mechanism is REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET env var which is read as a base and centrality-scaled, making it not a true cap override
ProductionBatchRunner.run receives req.usd_budget but cannot apply it; the request is journaled but dropped with a WARNING and the computed cap is used instead
An optional cap_override parameter must thread through ProductionBatchRunner.run -> run_pass1 -> shed_to_budget, defaulting to None and used verbatim without centrality scaling
coverage["budget"] must record cap_source as 'override' or 'computed' to track which cap governed a run
The plan-review gate YAML currently sets no usd_budget, so live gate behavior remains unchanged until a separate cost-policy decision enables it
